subject: Design and Technology
weekly_outcome_verbatim: FOODWISE: plan a balanced meal on a budget.
scope: Week 1 only. Planning, not food preparation. Food in Weeks 1 to 3 then textiles in Weeks 4 to 6, using design make evaluate. Week 6 is assessing.
tier_basis: Explicit names from the current brief.
evidence: Completed pupil meal plan with ingredient quantities and costs, total within £2.00, and a pupil-owned one-line justification of balance. Keep actual support and book location. Practical approval is recorded separately.

model.dish: Cold bean and vegetable wrap with fruit and plain yoghurt
model.price_basis: All prices are invented for this lesson. Each price covers the stated amount for one person. These are ingredient-use costs, not the cost of buying whole packs. No spending or shopping is required. Water is available at no charge in this classroom model.
three_steps: With adult approval, wash the vegetables and fruit. Grate the carrot and finely slice the cabbage using the agreed tools. An adult can prepare these for you.
Use 80 g of ready-to-eat cooked beans, drained by an adult if needed. Mash with a fork. Mix in about 20 g of the plain yoghurt and the vegetables.
Put the filling on the wrap. Fold it. Serve with the washed fruit and the rest of the yoghurt. Keep it chilled until eaten and follow the adult’s plan.

fallback: Without food, equipment, printer or paper, read the price rows aloud. Pupils speak, sign or direct their ingredient choices. Rehearse the three steps with empty hands. An adult records exact choices, total and reason when a recording method is available. Mark transcription pending until it exists. This is planning or simulation, never a claim that the meal was prepared.
safety_basis: Original teaching wording checked against current public balanced eating, food hygiene, chilling and allergy guidance on 30 October 2026. No outside pages, addresses, copied guidance or named suppliers are included. Actual label, dietary, tool, storage and supervision checks remain necessary before the later practical.
scheme_literal_exception: The supplied FOODWISE wording remains verbatim in the weekly outcome. It is not added as a supplier, product or credit.

visual_provenance.basis: The accepted original chassis, logo and document proportions were used as the visual reference. New teaching content is authored for this brief.
